No QCore syntax expresses it, so the case's artifact is the C twin in case.c, analyzed through the real unrestricted-C gateway. The scenario expects `Unknown; no whole-program proof`, and that is what the gateway reports: the registration is a call whose effect on `arg` no contract declares, so the projection is withdrawn rather than completed. Nothing here decides when the callback runs; the measurement is that no proof is issued in its absence.
